<p class="proj-intro">I teach comparative and European politics, research design and migration policy at BA, MA and PhD level, in English, French and German.</p>

<!-- GAP (optional): two or three sentences on how you teach, written by Philipp -->

## Thesis supervision {#theses}

I am happy to supervise theses on the politics of migration, public opinion and European integration, and I particularly welcome theses with a quantitative-comparative design. Please send me a short [email](mailto:p.lutz@vu.nl) with your research question and the data you plan to use.
